description: The log's final hash, the downloadable evidence bundle, the report's SHA-256 from the release manifest, and the one command that checks the bundle with only Python. The verifier checks log and artifact integrity and that the report names the log's head hash; it does not check the report's contents against the log.

paper.description: arXiv ID (1607.01759), DOI (10.1126/science.abb9789), an arXiv/doi.org/openrepro.org URL, the paper's title, or a name it is known by (fastText, PINNs, the Leiden algorithm)

name: how_to_verify
title: How to verify a report's evidence
